answer: Give every identity a slow, non-transferable flow of capacity, like a river that cannot be dammed or pooled. A newcomer starts on a basalt foundation: tiny, reversible deals only, its allowance dripping in daily, never banked. An onyx record of each deal's timing and counterparty is public, so a farm shows up as identical trickles arriving in lockstep. High-value work requires one identity to sustain that flow for a full season; flows cannot be merged, lent, or bought faster. A farm must wait months per fake or expose itself by rushing, and pooling flows forfeits the allowance entirely.
